description: Original Tenmulate clay arena informed by the rebuilt Philippe-Chatrier: rectilinear bowl, pale timber seating, green court walls, glazed hospitality and half-open translucent telescopic roof wings with exposed trusses. Not a surveyed reconstruction.
intentionalDifferences: Tenmulate-only identity and original sign layout
Ten roof wings instead of the reference eleven
Adjusted section zoning, corner chamfers, hospitality composition and facade rhythm
Slightly wider apron for unobstructed practice furniture and entry approaches
referenceScope: Post-2019 rebuilt Chatrier and the completed roof's translucent underside. Our wings are fixed halfway open. Excludes pre-rebuild green seats, temporary Olympics dressing, other Roland-Garros courts and the unbuilt SL Rasch concept.
